text: Rival sprite appears standing on top of player's house roof. After the last text box, the rival sprite fades in standing on top of the red roof of the player's house, above the building.

Player sprite vanishes in Pallet Town near Oak's lab. After moving right toward the big red-roofed building (Oak's lab), Red disappears from the HD view. The camera stays on empty sand and no player sprite is drawn. The minimap in the top-right still shows the player icon, and the text map confirms movement.

Original Game Boy screen flashes full-screen when rival talks in Oak's lab. For about a quarter to half a second the full original Game Boy screen (grey lab with the Game Boy sprites) takes over the whole display, then the HD view returns with the HD text box.

Game Boy screen inset in top-right corner shows the original text box while HD dialogue plays. The corner inset is a live Game Boy-style screen. It shows the original GB text box 'RED: Yo / Claude! Gramps / isn't around!' while the HD text box is also on screen. It also shows the lab in GB style all the time, not just the map.

Pokédex shows 4 caught before any starter is taken (includes #002). Header reads '4 caught · 0 seen of 151'. Caught tab lists 001, 002, 004, 007. Two of those are not starters (#002 is Ivysaur, not on offer), and no Pokémon is owned.

A on a starter Poké Ball opens Pokédex entry instead of take prompt. The full-screen Pokédex entry for Charmander (No.004, About/Moves/Where/Grows) opens immediately. No choice is offered. The original Game Boy screen also flashed for 0.3 s during the transition.

Saves screen: 'Save now' gives no feedback and still says 'saved 1 minute ago'. Nothing visible happens. The card still reads 'saved 1 minute ago' even though the Me tab a moment earlier said 'Saved just now'.

Battle: player's CHARMANDER sprite not drawn; foe SQUIRTLE is a blurred oversize shape. No Charmander sprite is drawn anywhere on the battle screen. The foe Squirtle is a large blurred pale-blue blob in the top middle, and the lab background sits behind the GB menu boxes. The Game Boy text and menu boxes sit on top of that HD background.
Currency symbol mismatch: Game Boy text says ¥, HD Trainer card says ₽. The GB text box shows '¥175' while the HD Me/Trainer card shows 'Money ₽3,000' and the 'Earned ₽0 / spent ₽0' lines use ₽.

Question: after the rival battle in Oak's lab, Charmander was at 3/22 HP. Later (Inventory tab, around 20 turns later, after 'Saved!' toasts and walking out of the lab) it read 22/22 with no Pokémon Center visit. Is this an intended auto-heal (on save / leaving a lab?) or a bug? Also: Save now seems to save a few seconds late ('Saved!' toast appeared after the dialogue, not on tap).

Full-screen Game Boy screen flashes for a moment after wild battles end. The original Game Boy screen shows full-screen for about 0.3-0.4 s on the bottom edge after the level-up text, then the HD view resumes. Same kind of flash seen earlier in Oak's lab. Also, a toast '✓ Saved' appeared at the same time (auto-save), and the corner Game Boy inset is showing a live Game Boy view.

Rival intro 'RED wants to fight!' Game Boy box ignores taps; only the A button advances it. Tapping the Game Boy text box does nothing. Only the A button (477,890) advances it. This is inconsistent with the HD text boxes, which take taps.
Red's house 1F view is off-centre with a black void to the right. The camera is cropped and off-centre, with a black void on the right side of the screen beyond the room's walls.

Question: at Viridian Mart, after getting Oak's Parcel, the clerk only repeats 'Say hi to PROF.OAK for me!' and no shop menu opens. Is that intended (shop gated until the parcel is delivered, like the original), or is the Mart shop missing? I'm taking the parcel to Oak in Pallet and will retry afterwards. No need to wait.

Extra detail for #10 (GB flash after wild battle). Sequence in the contact sheet from the Rattata win: 'CHARMANDER gained 24 EXP. Points!' box stays about 2 s, then at about +3.0 s a full-screen grey/white GB-style frame shows, and at about +3.25 s it shows the GB Charmander stat box in the old GB font ('CHARMANDER Lv7 24/24'), before the overworld fades in at about +3.5 s. Also, the overworld stays heavily blurred/washed out for several seconds after the battle (screenshots at turns 18-21), so it may be a leftover transition overlay.

Is the heavy blur on the Viridian City overworld intended? Everything except the player sprite looks strongly blurred (like a depth-of-field effect), and it stays on after the Route 1 battle. Also: Me tab 'Played' says 0:20 after a long session, so I want to know whether that's the save time reset or a bug. Also #7 looks fixed: 'Save now' shows a 'Saved!' toast now.

In Viridian City, walking north between the two green-roofed houses (just south of the big dark-tree block up north), I get blocked with 'You can't go through here!' then 'This is private property!'. Two NPCs stand just to the upper-left. Is this an intended block (e.g. the Oak's aide Pokédex check, which needs more Pokémon caught), or a bug? And if it's intended, is there another way north to Route 2? I have 1 caught, 4 seen.
